title: First Missing Positive
description: Find the smallest missing positive integer in an unsorted array.
pseudocode:
1. for i = 0 to n-1: while nums[i] > 0 and nums[i] <= n and nums[nums[i]-1] != nums[i]: swap(nums[i], nums[nums[i]-1])
2. for i = 0 to n-1: if nums[i] != i + 1: return i + 1
3. return n + 1

steps.note: Initial state: swapping nums[0] (3) into index 2.
Moving to i=1, nums[1] is 4. Swapping 4 to index 3.
After swapping 4, nums[1] is 1. Swapping 1 to index 0.
Checking for missing positive. Index 0 is correct (1).
Index 1 should be 2, but found -1. Returning 2.
